test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Meenal asked Jay where Gauri can be found.

options.text: “Can I find Gauri?” Meenal asked Jay.
“Where can I find Gauri?” Meenal asked Jay.
“Where do I find Gauri?” Jay asked Meenal.
“Where to find Gauri?” Meenal asked Jay.

solution:
The correct answer is '**“Where can I find Gauri?” Meenal asked Jay.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The conversion from indirect to direct speech involves understanding of reported speech rules in grammar.
 
• In the provided sentence, 'Meenal asked Jay' indicates that Meenal is the speaker.
 
• Thus, the direct speech must start with **Meenal's words.**
 
• In indirect speech, reporting verbs like "asked", and "enquired", etc. followed by a question word like "where", "what", "how", etc. 
 
• When changing from direct to indirect speech and vice versa, the tense of the sentence will often change to match the tense of the reporting verb. 
 
 
• From Indirect to direct speech, tense will change from simple past to simple present.
 
 
 
• 'Where Gauri can be found' should be converted to '**Where can I find Gauri'** to make it a direct question.
 
• This follows the rules of changing indirect questions to direct questions, where the sequence of subject and verb in the reported speech is reversed.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
